{"code":"ZBX-E0103","severity":"error","blame":"environment","summary":"cgroup v2 is not set up for this user","causes":["the cgroup delegated to uid 1000 lacks controllers: cpu memory","systemd delegates only some controllers to user services by default, and the cgroup.controllers of this user's manager does not list these: cpu memory"],"while":["running the cgroup check of zbx doctor"],"context":{"kernel":"6.8.0-45-generic","uid":"1000"},"fixes":[{"sentence":"create the drop-in directory:","command":"sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d","needs_root":true},{"sentence":"delegate the controllers:","command":"printf '[Service]\\nDelegate=cpu cpuset io memory pids\\n' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d/delegate.conf","needs_root":true},{"sentence":"reload, then log in again:","command":"sudo systemctl daemon-reload","needs_root":true}],"docs":"https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0103.html","omitted":{"causes":0,"while":0,"context":0,"fixes":0}}
